components.role_description: sequence of test cases, each containing room count, friend count, friend positions and tree edges
edges of the undirected tree connecting rooms

constraints.name: tree_topology
constraints.description: The system of rooms and corridors forms an undirected tree with n nodes and n-1 edges, connected without cycles.
constraints.formal: Graph G = (V, E) is a tree, |V|=n, |E|=n-1, connected, acyclic.

constraints.name: vlad_start
constraints.description: Vlad starts the game in room 1.

constraints.name: vlad_win_condition
constraints.description: Vlad wins if he reaches a room other than 1 that has exactly one incident corridor (a leaf node distinct from the start).
constraints.formal: win_V ≡ ∃ leaf l ≠ 1 such that Vlad arrives at l before any friend meets him

constraints.name: friends_initial_positions
constraints.description: There are k friends, initially placed at distinct rooms x_i (2 ≤ x_i ≤ n); no two friends share the same room.

constraints.name: simultaneous_unit_moves
constraints.description: All participants move simultaneously; each can traverse at most one corridor per unit of time.
constraints.formal: ∀ time step, each participant moves to an adjacent node or stays; moves happen in parallel.

constraints.name: optional_stay
constraints.description: Participants may choose not to move during a time unit.

constraints.name: unlimited_room_capacity
constraints.description: Each room can hold any number of participants simultaneously.

constraints.name: friend_capture_condition
constraints.description: Friends win if at least one of them meets Vlad on a node or edge before Vlad reaches his winning leaf.
constraints.formal: win_F ≡ ∃ time t, ∃ friend f, location(f, t) = location(V, t) (node or edge) and win_V has not occurred by t

constraints.name: minimal_friend_subset
constraints.description: Determine the minimum size of a subset of friends such that they can always catch Vlad regardless of Vlad's moves; if no such subset exists, output -1.
constraints.formal: ans = min{ |S| : S ⊆ friends, S can guarantee capturing Vlad before he wins } or -1 if no S exists

objective.description: Minimize the minimum number of friends required to guarantee catching Vlad, or determine if such a subset does not exist.

invariants.name: node_occupation_exclusivity
invariants.description: 每个节点至多被一个朋友占据,且一旦被确定为某个朋友所占据,该关系在整个后续模拟中保持不变。

invariants.name: interception_distance_condition
invariants.description: 在算法交替扩展中,当Vlad到达的节点已被朋友占据时,该朋友从初始位置到该节点的距离总是小于或等于Vlad从起点到该节点的距离。

invariants.name: indispensable_blocking_set
invariants.description: 算法在扩展过程中记录的 needed 集合是任意可行拦截方案都必须包含的朋友集合,其势即为所求的最小朋友数（若可达叶节点则为无解）。
